1	"""T033: Per-individual diagnostics collector for sidecar emission.
     2	
     3	Stage A/B/C 評価結果を generation 中に蓄積し、GA 完了時に sidecar Parquet として
     4	flush する。production GA 経路から fail-open で利用される。
     5	
     6	archive Parquet schema は touch しない。post-RUN で
     7	``reports/run-reports/run-{N}/diagnostics/stage_a_provenance.parquet`` に出力する。
     8	
     9	詳細: devnotes/20260425-0937-cost-pnl-ledger-eventsource/
    10	"""
    11	
    12	from __future__ import annotations
    13	
    14	import math
    15	from dataclasses import dataclass
    16	from typing import Any, Final
    17	
    18	from src.alpha_factory.stage_gate import StageResult
    19	
    20	__all__ = [
    21	    "VALID_METRIC_STAGES",
    22	    "DiagnosticsCollector",
    23	    "IndividualDiagnostics",
    24	]
    25	
    26	# metric_stage の解釈: 「到達した最高通過段」(pass-based)
    27	# stage_a_only      = Stage A 不通過 (または Stage B/C 未評価)
    28	# stage_a_evaluated = Stage A 通過 (Stage B 未評価 / 不通過)
    29	# stage_b_evaluated = Stage B 通過 (Stage C 未評価 / 不通過)
    30	# stage_c_evaluated = Stage C 通過
    31	VALID_METRIC_STAGES: Final[frozenset[str]] = frozenset(
    32	    {
    33	        "stage_a_only",
    34	        "stage_a_evaluated",
    35	        "stage_b_evaluated",
    36	        "stage_c_evaluated",
    37	    }
    38	)
    39	
    40	
    41	@dataclass
    42	class IndividualDiagnostics:
    43	    """Per-individual diagnostics record (mutable during a generation)."""
    44	
    45	    lane_id: str
    46	    generation: int
    47	    individual_name: str
    48	    trade_count: int = 0
    49	    total_pnl_stage_a: float = 0.0
    50	    sharpe_stage_a: float | None = None
    51	    stage_a_pass: bool = False
    52	    stage_b_pass: bool | None = None  # None = not evaluated
    53	    stage_c_pass: bool | None = None  # None = not evaluated
    54	
    55	
    56	class DiagnosticsCollector:
    57	    """In-memory collector for per-individual stage diagnostics.
    58	
    59	    Lifecycle:
    60	    - Created in run_ga.py with run-level scope
    61	    - Updated by stage_gate / swim_lane after each StageResult is produced
    62	    - Flushed to Parquet sidecar at GA completion (writer は別モジュール)
    63	
    64	    主キー: ``(lane_id, generation, individual_name)`` の複合キー
    65	    (既存 archive と整合)。同一キーの再記録は last-write-wins。
    66	    """
    67	
    68	    def __init__(self) -> None:
    69	        self._records: dict[tuple[str, int, str], IndividualDiagnostics] = {}
    70	
    71	    def _key(
    72	        self, lane_id: str, generation: int, individual_name: str
    73	    ) -> tuple[str, int, str]:
    74	        return (lane_id, generation, individual_name)
    75	
    76	    def record_stage_a(
    77	        self,
    78	        lane_id: str,
    79	        generation: int,
    80	        individual_name: str,
    81	        result: StageResult,
    82	    ) -> None:
    83	        """Stage A 結果を記録。同一キー再記録は last-write-wins (idempotent)."""
    84	        payload_obj: Any = (
    85	            result.metrics.get("payload", {})
    86	            if hasattr(result, "metrics")
    87	            else {}
    88	        )
    89	        if not isinstance(payload_obj, dict):
    90	            payload: dict[str, Any] = {}
    91	        else:
    92	            payload = payload_obj
    93	        # Defensive read: payload may lack new fields if older code path
    94	        trade_count = int(payload.get("trade_count", 0) or 0)
    95	        total_pnl_raw = payload.get("total_pnl", 0.0)
    96	        try:
    97	            total_pnl = float(total_pnl_raw) if total_pnl_raw is not None else 0.0
    98	        except (TypeError, ValueError):
    99	            total_pnl = 0.0
   100	        if not math.isfinite(total_pnl):
   101	            total_pnl = 0.0
   102	        sharpe_raw = payload.get("trade_sharpe_raw")
   103	        sharpe_stage_a: float | None = None
   104	        if sharpe_raw is not None:
   105	            try:
   106	                v = float(sharpe_raw)
   107	                if math.isfinite(v):
   108	                    sharpe_stage_a = v
   109	            except (TypeError, ValueError):
   110	                sharpe_stage_a = None
   111	        self._records[self._key(lane_id, generation, individual_name)] = (
   112	            IndividualDiagnostics(
   113	                lane_id=lane_id,
   114	                generation=generation,
   115	                individual_name=individual_name,
   116	                trade_count=trade_count,
   117	                total_pnl_stage_a=total_pnl,
   118	                sharpe_stage_a=sharpe_stage_a,
   119	                stage_a_pass=bool(result.passed),
   120	            )
   121	        )
   122	
   123	    def record_stage_b(
   124	        self,
   125	        lane_id: str,
   126	        generation: int,
   127	        individual_name: str,
   128	        passed: bool,
   129	    ) -> None:
   130	        """Stage B pass/fail を記録。Stage A 未記録なら no-op (defensive)."""
   131	        rec = self._records.get(
   132	            self._key(lane_id, generation, individual_name)
   133	        )
   134	        if rec is None:
   135	            return
   136	        rec.stage_b_pass = bool(passed)
   137	
   138	    def record_stage_c(
   139	        self,
   140	        lane_id: str,
   141	        generation: int,
   142	        individual_name: str,
   143	        passed: bool,
   144	    ) -> None:
   145	        """Stage C pass/fail を記録。Stage A 未記録なら no-op (defensive)."""
   146	        rec = self._records.get(
   147	            self._key(lane_id, generation, individual_name)
   148	        )
   149	        if rec is None:
   150	            return
   151	        rec.stage_c_pass = bool(passed)
   152	
   153	    def derive_metric_stage(self, rec: IndividualDiagnostics) -> str:
   154	        """post-hoc metric_stage 確定 (collector 側で flush 時に決定)."""
   155	        if rec.stage_c_pass is True:
   156	            return "stage_c_evaluated"
   157	        if rec.stage_b_pass is True:
   158	            return "stage_b_evaluated"
   159	        if rec.stage_a_pass:
   160	            return "stage_a_evaluated"
   161	        return "stage_a_only"
   162	
   163	    def to_rows(self) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
   164	        """Materialize records as plain dicts for Parquet writing.
   165	
   166	        sidecar 出力の SSOT。CI invariant I2 を assert で保護
   167	        (metric_stage が enum 内であること)。
   168	        """
   169	        rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   170	        for rec in self._records.values():
   171	            metric_stage = self.derive_metric_stage(rec)
   172	            assert metric_stage in VALID_METRIC_STAGES, (
   173	                f"metric_stage out of enum: {metric_stage!r} "
   174	                f"(rec={rec})"
   175	            )
   176	            rows.append(
   177	                {
   178	                    "lane_id": rec.lane_id,
   179	                    "generation": rec.generation,
   180	                    "individual_name": rec.individual_name,
   181	                    "metric_stage": metric_stage,
   182	                    "trade_count": rec.trade_count,
   183	                    "total_pnl_stage_a": rec.total_pnl_stage_a,
   184	                    "sharpe_stage_a": rec.sharpe_stage_a,
   185	                    "stage_a_pass": rec.stage_a_pass,
   186	                    "stage_b_pass": rec.stage_b_pass,
   187	                    "stage_c_pass": rec.stage_c_pass,
   188	                }
   189	            )
   190	        return rows
   191	
   192	    def __len__(self) -> int:
   193	        return len(self._records)

1	"""T033: Stage A diagnostics sidecar writer.
     2	
     3	DiagnosticsCollector が蓄積した per-individual records を
     4	``reports/run-reports/run-{N}/diagnostics/stage_a_provenance.parquet`` に
     5	出力する。production GA からは fail-open で呼ばれる
     6	(書き込みエラー時は warning ログのみ、GA は止めない)。
     7	
     8	T058: schema v2 propagate (詳細設計 § 施策 7)
     9	- STAGE_A_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA に v2 必須 2 field を先頭追加
    10	  (diagnostics_schema_version / dataset_epoch_id)
    11	- ``build_sidecar_table`` / ``write_stage_a_provenance`` に optional
    12	  ``run_context`` / ``mode`` kwargs を追加 (既存 caller 完全互換、
    13	  default で旧挙動維持)
    14	- ``run_context`` 未指定時は ``"epoch_legacy"`` を fallback として補完
    15	- ``mode=LOG_ONLY`` default、 ``FAIL_CLOSED`` で必須 field 欠落 raise
    16	
    17	詳細: devnotes/20260425-0937-cost-pnl-ledger-eventsource/
    18	      devnotes/20260429-1912-todo-T058-schema-v2-contract/detailed-design.md § 施策 7
    19	"""
    20	
    21	from __future__ import annotations
    22	
    23	from collections.abc import Sequence
    24	from pathlib import Path
    25	from typing import Any, Final
    26	
    27	import pyarrow as pa
    28	import pyarrow.parquet as pq
    29	import structlog
    30	
    31	from src.alpha_factory.diagnostics_collector import DiagnosticsCollector
    32	from src.alpha_factory.run_context import RunContext
    33	from src.alpha_factory.schema_contract import (
    34	    DIAGNOSTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    35	    SchemaEnforcementMode,
    36	    assert_diagnostics_v2,
    37	)
    38	
    39	logger = structlog.get_logger(__name__)
    40	
    41	__all__ = [
    42	    "STAGE_A_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA",
    43	    "build_sidecar_table",
    44	    "sidecar_relative_path",
    45	    "write_stage_a_provenance",
    46	]
    47	
    48	# sidecar Parquet schema (T033 SSOT + T058 v2)
    49	# 主キー: (lane_id, generation, individual_name)
    50	# T058: 先頭 2 field は schema v2 必須 (diagnostics_schema_version / dataset_epoch_id)
    51	STAGE_A_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA: Final[pa.Schema] = pa.schema(
    52	    [
    53	        # T058 schema v2 必須 (詳細設計 行 1147-1164)
    54	        pa.field("diagnostics_schema_version", pa.int32(), nullable=False),
    55	        pa.field("dataset_epoch_id", pa.string(), nullable=False),
    56	        # 既存 10 列 (T033)
    57	        pa.field("lane_id", pa.string(), nullable=False),
    58	        pa.field("generation", pa.int32(), nullable=False),
    59	        pa.field("individual_name", pa.string(), nullable=False),
    60	        pa.field("metric_stage", pa.string(), nullable=False),
    61	        pa.field("trade_count", pa.int32(), nullable=False),
    62	        pa.field("total_pnl_stage_a", pa.float64(), nullable=False),
    63	        pa.field("sharpe_stage_a", pa.float64(), nullable=True),
    64	        pa.field("stage_a_pass", pa.bool_(), nullable=False),
    65	        pa.field("stage_b_pass", pa.bool_(), nullable=True),
    66	        pa.field("stage_c_pass", pa.bool_(), nullable=True),
    67	    ]
    68	)
    69	
    70	
    71	def sidecar_relative_path(run_number: int) -> Path:
    72	    """sidecar Parquet の相対 path SSOT.
    73	
    74	    summary.json の `diagnostics_sidecar` field と consumer (run-report skill)
    75	    が同じ path を参照できるよう一元化する。
    76	    """
    77	    return Path(
    78	        f"reports/run-reports/run-{run_number}/diagnostics/"
    79	        "stage_a_provenance.parquet"
    80	    )
    81	
    82	
    83	def build_sidecar_table(
    84	    rows: Sequence[dict[str, Any]],
    85	    *,
    86	    run_context: RunContext | None = None,
    87	    mode: SchemaEnforcementMode = SchemaEnforcementMode.LOG_ONLY,
    88	) -> pa.Table:
    89	    """rows (DiagnosticsCollector.to_rows() 出力) から pyarrow Table を構築。
    90	
    91	    T058: v2 必須 field (diagnostics_schema_version / dataset_epoch_id) を
    92	    補完 + ``assert_diagnostics_v2`` で passive validation。
    93	
    94	    Args:
    95	        rows: DiagnosticsCollector が蓄積した per-individual record の list。
    96	        run_context: T058 optional — 注入されていれば ``dataset_epoch_id`` を
    97	            ここから補完。 ``None`` の場合は ``"epoch_legacy"`` fallback。
    98	        mode: schema enforcement mode (LOG_ONLY default)。
    99	
   100	    Returns:
   101	        v2 必須 field を含む pyarrow Table。
   102	    """
   103	    enriched: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
   104	    fallback_epoch_id = (
   105	        run_context.dataset_epoch_id if run_context is not None else "epoch_legacy"
   106	    )
   107	    for row in rows:
   108	        # caller 側 dict の mutate 防止のため shallow copy
   109	        enriched_row = dict(row)
   110	        if not enriched_row.get("dataset_epoch_id"):
   111	            enriched_row["dataset_epoch_id"] = fallback_epoch_id
   112	        enriched_row.setdefault(
   113	            "diagnostics_schema_version", DIAGNOSTICS_SCHEMA_VERSION
   114	        )
   115	        # passive validation (LOG_ONLY: warning のみ / FAIL_CLOSED: raise)
   116	        assert_diagnostics_v2(enriched_row, mode=mode)
   117	        enriched.append(enriched_row)
   118	    return pa.Table.from_pylist(enriched, schema=STAGE_A_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA)
   119	
   120	
   121	def write_stage_a_provenance(
   122	    collector: DiagnosticsCollector,
   123	    output_path: Path,
   124	    *,
   125	    run_context: RunContext | None = None,
   126	    mode: SchemaEnforcementMode = SchemaEnforcementMode.LOG_ONLY,
   127	) -> Path | None:
   128	    """sidecar Parquet を書き出す。
   129	
   130	    fail-open: I/O エラー / schema mismatch 時は warning + None 返却で
   131	    GA 完走を妨げない (既存挙動維持)。
   132	
   133	    T058: v2 propagate (run_context / mode を ``build_sidecar_table`` に伝搬)。
   134	
   135	    T067 移行ノート: T067 で FAIL_CLOSED を default 化する際、 本関数の
   136	    既存 fail-open ガード (try/except: warning + None) は ``mode`` 引数だけ
   137	    切替えても挙動が変わらない。 T067 切替時は (a) ``mode`` default を
   138	    FAIL_CLOSED に変える、 もしくは (b) try/except の捕捉範囲を I/O 系のみに
   139	    限定して ``SchemaContractError`` を再送出させる、 のいずれかが必要。
   140	    詳細設計 行 1192-1203 を参照。
   141	
   142	    Args:
   143	        collector: GA run-level の DiagnosticsCollector。
   144	        output_path: 出力 Parquet path (絶対 or 相対)。
   145	        run_context: T058 optional — ``dataset_epoch_id`` 補完用。
   146	        mode: schema enforcement mode (LOG_ONLY default)。
   147	
   148	    Returns:
   149	        書き込み成功時 ``output_path``、失敗時 ``None``。
   150	    """
   151	    rows = collector.to_rows()
   152	    if not rows:
   153	        logger.info(
   154	            "diagnostics_sidecar.empty",
   155	            reason="no_individuals_recorded",
   156	            output_path=str(output_path),
   157	        )
   158	        return None
   159	    try:
   160	        table = build_sidecar_table(rows, run_context=run_context, mode=mode)
   161	        output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   162	        pq.write_table(table, output_path)
   163	    except Exception as exc:
   164	        # fail-open: GA を止めない、warning のみ
   165	        # ただし FAIL_CLOSED 由来の SchemaContractError は意図的に表面化させたい
   166	        # ところだが、 既存契約 (Path | None 返却) を破壊しないため warning に
   167	        # 落として None 返却する (詳細設計 § 施策 7 行 1201-1203)。
   168	        logger.warning(
   169	            "diagnostics_sidecar.write_failure",
   170	            output_path=str(output_path),
   171	            error=str(exc),
   172	            error_type=type(exc).__name__,
   173	        )
   174	        return None
   175	    logger.info(
   176	        "diagnostics_sidecar.written",
   177	        output_path=str(output_path),
   178	        row_count=len(rows),
   179	    )
   180	    return output_path
